design.act: test whether the signs Asset A classes as sky_cycle are enriched in text-final position in the pinned corpus, against a frequency-matched comparison class, with the class taken from the frozen Asset A only and every gate run before any final-position quantity
design.claim_status: UNTESTED (Phase-104, RULE-CLASS: the falsifier requires a defined class of celestial signs and no such classification existed in the repository's data; the Phase-104 record read at this freeze carries verdict stays_untested under rule RULE-CLASS)
design.hypothesis: the pooled final-position rate of Asset A's sky_cycle signs exceeds the pooled final-position rate of the frequency-matched comparison class by an enrichment ratio of at least 1.5, with Fisher's exact test at the 5% level and at least half the class's occurrences from signs individually above the corpus-wide final-position rate (spec sections 1.3 and 4.3; F050-C03)

asset_a.form: the depicted-kind classification built and frozen inside Spec 045 (design D-05) at its execution step 1, in specs/045-hunt-depicted-kinds/asset-a/depicted-kind-classification.csv with asset-a/asset-a-freeze.json recording its SHA-256 - NOT built at this freeze and NOT in existence at this freeze
asset_a.pin_timing: coordinator ruling DD-050-11: Asset A is built at Spec 045's execution step 1 (Wave 3), so asset-a-freeze.json does not exist yet at this freeze; this freeze quotes Spec 045's freeze digest as the contract anchor and fixes the pin source; gate 0.1 asserts that SHA-256 at execution step 0
asset_a.gate_0_1: the digest read from the fixed pin source is asserted against the recomputed SHA-256 of the canonical CSV before any join or counting: mismatch closes the execution as CLOSED AT STEP 0 - ASSET PIN MISMATCH; an unfrozen or absent asset closes it as CLOSED AT STEP 0 - ASSET NOT FROZEN, exactly as drafted
asset_a.celestial_class: exactly the set of signs whose Asset A row carries depicted_kind = sky_cycle, one row per sign keyed by the pinned crosswalk identity (DD-050-1, frozen at DD-050-13); contested signs are excluded from the primary and enter only sensitivity S2 under their CISI-governed sky_cycle labels; unidentified signs are never celestial
asset_a.untested_boundary: the broader closing notion - Hunt's closing part read to include jurisdiction signs - is NOT tested here, in either direction: no jurisdiction-coded sign, no sign whose verbatim label a reader judges celestial while its Asset A kind is object_goods, human, or other, and no sign classified by a worker's visual judgement is a member; the class is never silently widened (spec section 2.2; DD-050-1)

design.coverage_consequence: Spec 045 stands frozen with DD-045-18: Asset A covers the FULL pinned-crosswalk sign universe (187 distinct sign keys), gate A3 restated to that scope; this spec's gate 0.3 therefore does not close INVALID for want of corpus-wide coverage on that ground (DD-050-12)

test.ending: text-final position: the last sign of an inscription's recorded sequence in the pinned corpus, as counted by the pinned positional framework; a class's rate pools occurrences, not per-sign rates (spec section 4.1)
test.comparison_class: non-celestial, non-contested signs whose total occurrence counts lie between the smallest and the largest total counts among the primary celestial members, inclusive (DD-050-2); the corpus-wide final-position rate is published beside it and is the rate for the per-sign condition, never the primary denominator
test.fisher_exact: Fisher's exact test, two-sided (DD-050-4), on the pooled 2x2 table (celestial / comparison x final / non-final occurrences), at the 5% level

criteria.supported: enrichment ratio >= 1.5 and Fisher exact p < 0.05 and at least half the celestial class's occurrences from signs individually above the corpus-wide final-position rate
criteria.inconclusive: any other adjudicated case (ratio between 1.0 and 1.5, or ratio >= 1.5 failing the exact test or the half-of-occurrences condition)
criteria.too_thin: the recorded form of INCONCLUSIVE (DD-050-3): celestial class or comparison class totals fewer than 30 occurrences at gate 0.4, stated with its census and no rate computed

test.sensitivities: S1 borderline removed (celestial members with dispute_status = borderline removed); S2 contested included (contested signs whose CISI-governed label is a sky_cycle identification included under that label); both reported beside the primary, neither replacing its verdict word (spec section 4.5)
test.verdicts: SUPPORTED / NOT SUPPORTED / INCONCLUSIVE / TOO THIN, per spec section 4.3, with CLOSED AT STEP 0 - ASSET NOT FROZEN, CLOSED AT STEP 0 - ASSET PIN MISMATCH, INVALID, and NOT ADJUDICATED as closure classes

design.step0_gates: 0.1 asset digest assertion (DD-050-11); 0.2 input integrity - a mismatch stops the run as INVALID; 0.3 coverage and join completeness - every corpus sign carries exactly one Asset A row and every sky_cycle key resolves in the pinned crosswalk, else INVALID; 0.4 totals-only class census with the 30-occurrence TOO THIN floor; 0.5 positional reproduction (805 / 2,267 and the 40 / 61 / 20 classes), else INVALID; 0.6 freeze-order proof, else INVALID; no calibration beyond gate 0.5 is required (DD-050-15)
design.fences: position is not meaning; the class is the sky only; depiction is the published identification layer, not ground truth; Spec 037's 49 percent census caution travels with the asset and every verdict; negative, inconclusive, too-thin, closed, invalid, and not-adjudicated outcomes publish with the same prominence as a supported one (spec section 7)
design.execution_gate: NOT satisfied at the freeze of 2026-10-21: the OSF contract registration was filed at the freeze under E-1 and execution awaits its approval plus the campaign execution pass (Wave 3); Asset A does not exist at the freeze, no sign was classified, no census was taken, and no final-position quantity was computed
